title: Runescape: Dragonwilds | 8:32 Kuldra | 1.0.1 Day 1 Strats
author: Nano
offsetMethod: detected: end of the loading screen into the raid

textNotes.text: • Thanks to @Dotxygaming for the plunge-cancel tech!
• This run could be so much more clean, but I wanted to get the early strats posted so it could develop from here.
• zoop left side off rocks left of bridge towards top of pillar on left, needs decent height, may or may not need both dashes depending on strength of zoop
• respawn, since this uh... does that.
• windjump up to air door, from tip of rubble pile and go through
• exit through hole in wall above orb dispenser
• Air Thane takes like 15 minutes to respawn, it's best to just sleep through a night after completing a run... otherwise he doesn't spawn in the next run and ruins your time.

textNotes.author: @iNanobit
textNotes.text: At around 8:10 ish if I understand correctly? I'm touching the ground here before jumping. To get inside the heart you just have to enter it from approximately the top half, but the exact place you stand inside does matter a bit. If I'm misunderstanding sorry, but I might have an explainer video up soon for the whole run, including easier and harder routes. Kinda waiting to see what the next patch…
